html: † פִּתֹם n.pr.loc. Pithom, Π(ε)ιθω, A Πιθωμ (Egyptian Patum, Per-Atum, house of (god) Atum) one of the עָרֵי מִסְכְּנוֹת built by Isr. for Pharaoh Ex 1:11; identif. by Naville with Tel el-Maskhûta, near E. end of Wady Tumilat, Naville Pithom, 1885 Di-Ry ad loc. Di SBAk, 1885, 889 ff. BädEgypt (4), 159.
